summary: The definitive action puzzle game "ZOOKEEPER" is finally available on Android!
description:
10 million people are playing!
Zoo Keeper, the definitive action puzzle game
finally available for Android!
Aim for it! The Best Opp Zookeeper!

[game description]
This is a simple puzzle game with a simple rule: swap two panels next to each other, and line up three or more panels of the same color to make them disappear.

Touch the animal you want to move and slide it in the direction of the animal you want to replace.
If you line up 3 or more same animals vertically or horizontally, you can catch the animal.
The level is cleared when a quota of animals are caught.

[mode description]
*Normal Mode
Catch more than your quota of animals to clear all levels!

*Tokoton Mode
Level up with 100 animals! This is a challenging mode with unlimited time.

*Score Attack Mode
Try to score as many points as possible in a 3-minute challenge in Fever mode!

[ranking description].
Log in to the Play game to participate in the ranking. Compete with players around the world for high scores!
